description:
A scientific expedition from Blue Star discovered a strange humanoid corpse exposed in a vacuum on the planet Minglong. The expedition brought it back to Blue Star for research, but unexpectedly, they also brought disaster. The energy emanating from the humanoid corpse caused the entire Blue Star biosphere to enter a state of supernatural evolution. Fortunately, the humans on Blue Star were also within the biosphere and entered the supernatural evolutionary sequence, successively evolving into: Human-level, Earth-level, and Celestial-level evolvers. The seven most powerful Celestial-level evolvers were known as the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​protecting Hanxia in this chaotic world fraught with calamities. The anomalies on Blue Star attracted the attention of the Great Yu Empire, which ruled this star field. The Great Yu Empire believed that these anomalies might be related to a fugitive they were hunting. Therefore, taking advantage of the emergence of the Tenth Academy of the Starry Sky, they issued an academy trial, attracting a large number of students from combat academies to Blue Star under the guise of trials to find the fugitive and hone their new blood. On Blue Star, a young man named Lu Yin lies in hiding. He is unaware of his identity and origins; his earliest memories are of a bloody massacre, leaving him alone and stranded on Blue Star. As Blue Star undergoes a dramatic transformation, he realizes this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. He needs a clean new identity to return to that dangerous starry sea and seek revenge for the blood debts of the past. Thus, Lu Yin, the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​students of the Great Yu Empire, and various other forces enter the scene. On Blue Star, an unprecedented evolution and hunt is about to begin.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
